implementation_correction.reason: The published towed-video truth layer contains sampled georeferenced observation points rather than line-track geometry.
implementation_correction.primary_video_coverage_rule: A frozen candidate is video-covered iff at least one actual towed-video observation point lies inside its own frozen radius.
implementation_correction.unique_transect_count: Count distinct TransectID values among observation points inside the frozen candidate disk.
implementation_correction.nearest_video_distance: Minimum planar distance after transformation into the candidate bathymetry CRS.
implementation_correction.sediment_rule_unchanged: A sediment sample covers a candidate iff its georeferenced point lies inside the frozen candidate radius.
